notes: 2.3.8 release notes were broken (again) (sorry), so you can check out more information below.
NVST fixes (this fixes lag as well)
Controller fixes
You can now add your wifi name and the time to the status bar. Your location is not shared.
TV Enhancements to reduce lag on Space UI (default mode for new installs)
Apologies for the same release notes, there are some new things but I accidentally messed it up for last version cause I was trying to push it so quickly.
Release Notes fixes
Fixed default settings with mouse
Updated all languages to the latest translations
Published bugs screen
Updated Space UI to be more futuristic and less cluttered
Fixed the Android TV launcher banner so the full OpenNOW name is visible on an edge-to-edge background
Fixed the Android TV launcher banner
Added **Space UI** under **Settings > Interface**. Still experimental, landscape only, and a controller is recommended.
**On screen controls have their own settings page now**
Keyboard & mouse buttons are easier to find and customize
Touch control customization works better on smaller screens
Floating joysticks are now the default for new installs
You can now remember your input choice for each game
Games will now warn you if they're updating or under maintenance
**Recordings can now include your microphone and camera**
Fixed a recording folder crash on some devices
More **MediaCodec (Direct)** fixes
Improved reconnecting and alliance provider support with **experimental NVST**
Fixed a crash when connecting to a stream
Goofy has a screensaver now. Tap the avatar under **Settings > Interface** to try it
Added **Website client mode** under **Settings > Stream > Connection**. Native touch is disabled while using it.
**Your library loads faster now, and it's fixed.**
Fixed games showing up in your library that weren't added to it
**Direct click is more accurate now**
Smoother video with **MediaCodec (Direct)**
Controller Sizing Changes
DPad fixes
Improved streaming performance, especially on **Android TV**
Improved controller support with **experimental NVST**
Game covers look better on **Android TV**
Goofy can now pop up from any edge of the screen
Added **Changelogs** to Settings so release notes are easy to find.
After a Google Play update, the new notes appear once when you open the app.
**On screen Controller deadzoneing is now fixed**.
**Rare queue failures are now fixed**
A new, experimental option that may potentially reduce lag is avaliable. You can find it under **Settings > Stream > Video Output > __MediaCodec (Direct)__**.
The status bar can now be moved around. While in stream, **Back/swipe to go back > Status bar > Status bar drag mode**.
You can now display your current playtime in the status bar. While in stream, **Back/swipe to go back > Status bar > Show playtime**.
Reduced the amount of lag that was being caused from debug logging
Free tier bugs can now be overidden
Cursor is a little bit more smoother now
Fix mouse & kb detection for certain devices
Premium games will now be marked
Game details are parsed a little better
On screen Controller are more responsive now
